episodeTitle.en: How to launch and grow your product | Ryan Hoover of Product Hunt and Weekend Fund
episodeTitle.zh: 如何推出并发展你的产品 | Product Hunt和Weekend Fund的瑞安·胡佛

guestBioOfficial.en: Thousands of new products launch each year, but very few last. Ryan Hoover has seen thousands of products launched over the course of his time running Product Hunt and through his investing, and in this episode you’ll hear what Ryan has learned about launching products, growing products, and raising capital. Plus, we play a made-up game called “What would you rather upvote?” Join us!
guestBioOfficial.zh: 每年有成千上万的新产品推出，但极少能长久存续。瑞安·胡佛在运营Product Hunt期间及投资经历中见证了数千款产品的诞生。在本期节目中，您将听到瑞安在产品推出、产品发展及融资方面的深刻见解。此外，我们还将玩一个虚构的游戏——“你更愿意点赞什么？”。快来加入我们吧！

title.en: How to launch and grow your product | Ryan Hoover of Product Hunt and Weekend Fund
title.zh: 如何推出并发展你的产品 | Product Hunt和Weekend Fund的瑞安·胡佛

summary.en: Ryan reflects on the surreal experience of building Product Hunt into a tech institution and the hidden weight of public recognition, while openly discussing the anxiety and mask of confidence that come with being a founder/CEO. He shares lessons from his writing and investing, and the importance of community and showing up authentically. The conversation blends personal vulnerability with practical founder wisdom.
summary.zh: Ryan 回顾了将 Product Hunt 打造成科技圈标志性产品的超现实经历，以及公众知名度背后隐藏的重量，同时坦诚分享了身为创始人/CEO 伴随而来的焦虑与“自信面具”。他分享了写作与投资中的心得，以及社区与真诚在场的重要性。本期将个人的脆弱坦诚与务实的创始人智慧融为一体。
